items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: Elwood Thedover, he played saxophone. Arthur Cleese played saxophone. And I played the piano.

ctx.x: Elwood Thedover, he played saxophone. Arthur Cleese played saxophone. And I played the piano. Well that was around the time when this number Blue Skies came out. Oh yeah, Earthenbelly, isn't it? Earthenbelly is not. We had the band then. And we used to rehearse two or three times a week. We played two or three jobs at little dance halls and things like that, nothing notable, you know, just people would hire the band, we played for a couple of weddings, a couple of birthday parties. And so after they disbanded,…
They just paid you a flat sum, you didn't get tips or anything at the party?
